correctness.rationale: At scale one each maximal clique is a coordinate fiber, giving 36 points, 33 contractible fibers and 108 incidences: cycle rank 40. At scale two pairwise Hamming <=2 is exactly independence in K3 x K3 x K4. Independently enumerated all 30,992 augmented faces with precise f-vector (1,36,414,2028,4869,6804,6816,5184,3042,1324,396,72,6), constructed 15,448 disjoint deterministic toggle pairs, verified all 178,704 covering incidences and all 30,992 directed DAG nodes; 96 unmatched size-four faces and the empty/singleton pair imply a CW model with one vertex and 96 3-cells. Integral wedge follows from acyclic Morse, not Euler characteristic alone. Distances are integers 0-3 and r>=3 gives simplex; persistence degree zero and positive-degree intervals follow.
